content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the TISS Recruitment 2026 is 15th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the posts of Senior Administrative Assistant (Academic) and Administrative Assistant (Academic/Admission) in the TISS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized institution. A Master's Degree is also acceptable. Additionally, a typing speed of 30 w.p.m. in English and relevant secretarial work experience are required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years as of 31st August 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the TISS posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Senior Administrative Assistant (Academic) is Rs. 35,000/- per month, and for Administrative Assistant (Academic/Admission) it is Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 125/- for SC/ST candidates. Women candidates are exempt from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official TISS website or the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Interaction followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contract-based.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
